CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content present in text.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions) and an explicit organizational/origin field are both present for the same referent/time, and the text separates content listing from origin/status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries name color-labeled contents with position lists (red/blue) and referent nodes.

D.rationale: The report lists identified content (positions) separately from organizational/status fields (origin/flags) for the same node.

O.rationale: The text encodes how contents are presented/organized via node labels, candidate branches and explicit origin/represented_time fields.
